ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixel coverage against 35% high-intensity (white/light-grey) background pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centrally concentrated contiguous dark-pixel mass surrounding the median notch; high-frequency, fragmented dark-pixel clusters (mottling) distributed stochastically across the remainder of both lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 52 degrees and a deep vertical depth relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing boundary with high-amplitude peaks (8-15 pixels) near the distal tips and lower-frequency variations near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave curves originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep toward the outer distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular dark-pixel formations concentrated primarily on the outer edges and distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel horizontal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) clearly visible on the lower section of the right lobe (image-right).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible traumatic notch and irregular indentation on the far-right trailing edge boundary; scattered high-contrast scarring across the central-left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'salt-and-pepper' pigmentation density that is significantly higher than standard species-average distribution.
